name: Seller management create and list operations
description: A manager can create a new seller account and see it appear in the sellers list with correct details.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page and log in as manager
Navigate to the Sellers management page
Click the Add Seller or Create button
Enter a name in the seller name field
Enter a valid email address in the email field
Enter a phone number in the phone field
Click the Save or Submit button
Verify the seller is created successfully and appears in the sellers list with the entered name and email
